requirement: The engine shall load a master CSV whose rows list definition files with columns file_name, type and order
The engine shall accept master CSV type values state_machine, equations and inputs
The engine shall load one state machine per state_machine file in the master CSV
The engine shall use the master CSV order column to order state machines within their band
The engine shall share one ordering space within a band between state machines and equations
The engine shall ignore the master CSV order column for equations and inputs rows
The engine shall take a state machine's execution rate from the band column of its master CSV row, and an equation's rate from the band column of the equations file
The engine shall read all definition files including the master file as CSV with no YAML or JSON inputs
The engine shall build an immutable Model from the master CSV and the files it references
The engine shall read state machine CSV columns transition_id, current_state, next_state, default_state, equation, result_variable, rationale, title and order
The engine shall read equations CSV columns equation, explanation, rationale, result_variable, band and order
The engine shall read inputs CSV columns variable_name, type and default_value
The engine shall evaluate equations as Python-syntax Boolean expressions over context variable names
The engine shall assign the result of each standalone equation to its result_variable on every evaluation
The engine shall make a standalone equation result variable usable by name in state machine equations
The engine shall make a standalone equation result variable usable by name in other standalone equations
The engine shall not perform sandboxing or AST sanitization of expressions
The engine shall assign the result of each state machine row equation to its result_variable on every evaluation
The engine shall evaluate every row of every transition on every evaluation of its state machine so that result variables are always updated
The engine shall treat all rows sharing a transition_id as one transition
The engine shall AND the equations of a transition so that it is enabled only when all of them are true
The engine shall support transitions with differing numbers of equations within one state machine
The engine shall fire a non-global transition only when the state machine is in the transition current_state
The engine shall not fire a non-global transition whose equations are true when the state machine is not in its current_state
The engine shall treat a transition with empty current_state as global
The engine shall fire an enabled global transition from any state
The engine shall give global and non-global transitions no special precedence
The engine shall apply the first enabled transition in manual (band and order) sequence when several transitions are enabled in the same pass
The engine shall start each state machine in its default_state
The engine shall take the default state from the single row of the file that has default_state filled
The engine shall accept a transition whose next_state equals its current_state; a global transition to the current state is a no-op that still wins the pass and is not logged
The engine shall use each transition expression as written with no implicit negation or inhibit
The engine shall support multiple state machines up to MAX_STATE_MACHINES
The engine shall allow transition equations to reference result variables of other state machines through the shared context
The engine shall initialize every external input to its default_value from the inputs file at start
The engine shall make an input value set with set_input visible to equations at the next evaluation
The engine shall reject a result_variable (equation or transition row) named like an input so that only set_input writes inputs (assignment inside expressions is not checked: known limitation)
The engine shall make input variables usable by name in equations

The engine shall convert input default_value at load according to the type column (bool accepts true/false/1/0 case-insensitively; int; float; str) and reject an unknown type or a value that fails to convert
The engine shall treat each band as an explicit frequency in Hz
The engine shall not require any integer multiple or factor relationship between bands
The engine shall support bands such as 20 Hz and 30 Hz coexisting
The engine shall evaluate each item at the rate of its band
The engine shall evaluate all items sharing a band at the same rate
The engine shall use a tick rate equal to the least common multiple of all band frequencies
The engine shall make every band period a whole number of ticks
The engine shall use exact integer arithmetic for scheduling with no floating-point accumulation
The engine shall read band and order columns in the equations file, an order column in every state machine file, and order and band columns on master CSV state machine rows
The engine shall run items within a band in their manual order each time the band is scheduled
The engine shall let a later item see the result of an earlier item in the same pass
The engine shall let an earlier item see the previous pass value of a later item result
The engine shall not derive or infer execution order from dependencies
The engine shall build the execution plan ordered by (band, order) once at load
The engine shall never depend on dict or set iteration order for execution order
The engine shall recompute item values on every scheduled pass of their band
The engine shall apply at most one state change per state machine per pass
The engine shall evaluate an item only on ticks that are multiples of its band period
The engine shall evaluate all bands on the first step (tick 1, t = 0 ms)
The engine shall represent simulation time as an integer tick count
The engine shall increment simulation time at the start of each step
The engine shall derive t (absolute simulation time in milliseconds, (tick-1)*1000/tick_hz as an exact fraction) and dt (the item period in milliseconds) from the tick
The engine shall make t and dt (both in milliseconds) available to equations as context names
The engine shall run as fast as possible and not be synchronized to wall-clock time
The engine shall allow timer behavior to be expressed using t (absolute milliseconds) in equations independent of other bands
The engine shall reject an equation with a syntax error at load
The engine shall treat rows sharing a transition_id as one transition whether or not they are contiguous and AND their equations
The engine shall reject a transition referencing an unknown state at load
The engine shall reject a state machine file with zero default_state rows at load
The engine shall reject a state machine file with more than one default_state row at load
The engine shall reject at load a state machine file that has a band column (its band is set in the master CSV)
The engine shall reject at load rows sharing a transition_id that disagree on current_state or next_state
The engine shall reject at load a non-empty current_state that can never be entered (neither the default_state nor any transition next_state)
The engine shall reject a total equation count above MAX_EQUATIONS at load
The engine shall reject a state machine count above MAX_STATE_MACHINES at load
The engine shall count transition equations toward MAX_EQUATIONS
The engine shall define MAX_EQUATIONS and MAX_STATE_MACHINES as named constants and not per-component settings
The engine shall reject a non-positive or non-numeric band at load
The engine shall treat load-time checks as startup checks only and not as sandboxing
The engine shall compile each expression once at load using Python compile()
The engine shall evaluate pre-compiled code objects against the context at runtime without recompiling
The engine shall be an importable Python package
The engine shall provide Engine(model) as its constructor
The engine shall provide Engine.step() advancing simulation by one tick
The engine shall provide Engine.run(ticks) executing the given number of steps
The engine shall provide Engine.snapshot() returning tick, t (float milliseconds), states, outputs and inputs as an independent deep copy
The engine shall provide Engine.set_input(name, value) writing an external input
The engine shall implement the layered Loader, Scheduler, Evaluator, runtime state and trace hook design
The engine shall keep runtime state consisting of the context, the current state of each state machine and the tick
The engine shall expose the current state of every state machine in the snapshot
The engine shall expose every result_variable value in the snapshot
The engine shall expose both state machine row and standalone equation result variables in the snapshot
The engine shall return a snapshot that is a copy so that mutating it does not alter engine state
The engine shall reject set_input for a name not defined in the inputs file
The engine shall provide a trace hook callback recording each state change or result
The engine shall record a timestamp in each log entry
The engine shall record the component name in each log entry
The engine shall record an action or state change description in each log entry
The engine shall record the variable values involved in triggering the state change or action in each log entry
The engine shall support plain text log file output
The engine shall record a log entry for every state machine state change
The engine shall produce identical snapshots for identical runs with identical inputs
The engine shall produce identical logs for identical runs with identical inputs
The engine shall not use async or threads
The engine shall not use wall-clock time
The engine shall not use randomness
The engine shall be implemented in Python only
The engine shall exclude the front end, WebSocket server and orchestration server from the current phase
The engine shall not provide an event bus or event mechanism
The engine shall support command layer and monitoring layer logic using the same equation and state machine mechanisms
The engine shall allow a monitoring equation ordered after a command layer item to see its result in the same pass
The engine shall evaluate each state machine at the rate of its band, so a state change can occur only on a pass of that band
An item shall see an input only when its band runs; an input change that is reverted between two passes of the band is not seen by that item
The engine shall keep evaluating every item at its band rate for the whole run, with no drift in evaluation times over long runs
The inputs CSV shall accept the optional display columns group, widget, label, min, max, step, choices, lit_by and wide; files without them shall still load
The engine shall support an enum input type whose value is one of the choices column values ('|'-separated), with the default one of them

The loader shall reject invalid display definitions: a widget not allowed for the type, a slider without min and max, min not below max, a default outside min/max, choices on a non-enum, a lit push-button without lit_by, an unknown lit_by
A local Python server shall run a model given its master CSV on the command line, serve the page over HTTP and exchange values with it over a WebSocket; the engine runs only in Python
The server shall be a separate package so the engine package stays free of async code and wall-clock time
The page shall build its input cards and state machine cards from the loaded model, with no per-model code
The page shall show the state machines in master CSV row order, and each machine's states in the order of its CSV file
The page shall highlight the active state of every state machine, exactly one per machine, and follow state changes while running

Hovering over or focusing the active state shall highlight the targets of its own transitions (not global transition targets); hovering over an inactive state shall do nothing; highlighting shall not move or resize anything
The page shall not show equations, conditions, transitions, band rates, simulation time or tick
The page shall show one input card per input group, titled with the group name, with the group's inputs in CSV order
Switches, sliders, number fields, drop-downs and text fields shall write their input; the server shall check type, min/max and choices and reject other values
A push-button press shall hold its input true for one period of the slowest band and then set it false
A lit push-button shall be lit while its lit_by variable is true and unlit otherwise; the click alone shall not light it
The run controls shall offer real time and as fast as possible; in real time the server shall run ticks at the model tick rate against the wall clock
Pause shall stop the engine and become Resume; Step shall run one tick and be available only while paused
Reset shall return every input, state and result to its start value, keeping the loaded model, the run mode and the pause state
The server shall send screen updates at most 30 times per second while running
The splitter shall resize the two panes by dragging or with the arrow keys (20 px), keeping the left pane at least 280 px and the right pane at least 240 px
Names from the CSV files shall be shown as text, never interpreted as HTML
The server shall listen on 127.0.0.1 by default
Momentary push-buttons shall have a light grey fill and a dark outline; every push-button shall show visible feedback while held and for 0.3 s after each press
The master CSV shall accept an optional name column giving a state machine's display name; the page shall title each machine with it, or with the file name when it is empty
The page shall remember the divider position in the browser and restore it, within the pane limits, when the page is opened again; without stored data it shall use 440 px
The engine shall reject at load a master CSV state_machine row whose band is empty, not a number or not positive

The master CSV shall accept panel rows naming aircraft panel HTML files; the page shall show the panels in a full-width top pane above the left and right panes, always visible, at full size unless the window is too narrow, then scaled down to fit
Panel elements shall bind to variables with data-input (inputs), data-show (any variable) and data-lit-by (any variable); the loader shall reject an unknown or empty binding with its file:line

An input whose inputs CSV panel column names a panel shall be driven by that panel and get no input card; the loader shall reject a panel input the panel does not use, a data-input whose input does not name that panel, and a panel not listed in the master CSV
A toggle panel button shall flip its bool input on each press; a momentary panel button shall send a pulse like a momentary push-button
A panel knob shall set its int or float input within min and max (no wrap) in steps of step, by dragging, the mouse wheel or the keyboard
A panel readout shall show its variable's current value formatted with its data-format (printf-like: %d, %03d, %+05d, %.2f, %s)
A panel element with data-lit-by shall have the lit class while that variable is true, so lights follow the logic and not the click
Panel styles shall not affect the rest of the page, and scripts and inline event handlers in a panel file shall not run

A panel row of the master CSV may set a scale column (positive number, default 1); the panel shall be shown at that size with its proportions kept, and scaled down further only if the window is too narrow
The master CSV shall accept at most one actions row; the actions file has columns action and statement (optional rationale)
Each actions CSV row shall be one Python assignment (=, chained or augmented) to plain names; anything else is a load error with file:line
Rows sharing an action name shall run in file row order
An action statement shall write inputs only; writing an equation result, a state or an undeclared name is a load error
An input with widget none shall be an internal variable: accepted for every type and not shown on the front end
State machine rows may set action_type (entry, exit, during) and action; both or neither, and the action must be defined
When a transition fires its exit action shall run before the state changes and its entry action after; at most one of each per transition
A during action shall belong to its row's current_state and run on each pass in that state when no transition fires (a global self-transition counts as none); one per state
The master init_action column of a state machine row shall name an action run once on the machine's first pass before its transitions; empty runs nothing
Action writes shall be visible immediately to later items in the same pass and each changed variable shall be logged under the state machine name
Input controls shall show values written by actions on the next state update
Aircraft panels shall be shown side by side on one row in master CSV order; if the row is too wide for the window every panel shall be scaled down by the same factor
A TraceEvent shall carry optional structured fields kind (input, result, transition or action), name, old, new, trigger, label, title and phase, all with defaults so existing code keeps working

The trigger of an equation or a transition row shall be the names it read whose value differs from their value when it last read them (initial values before its first run); a row shall take its copy before it writes its result, so a result written by a later row or a variable written by the machine's own action counts as a change on the next pass
The names t, tick and dt shall never appear in a trigger, so a transition that only waits for a timer has an empty trigger
The trigger of a transition shall be the union of the triggers of its own rows in that pass, plus the gate rule of REQ-189
The trigger shall be exact for state machines running in different bands, because it is relative to the item's own previous run
The text trace output shall be unchanged by the structured fields

The Timeline recorder shall turn trace events into JSON-ready items with sequential ids: transition items (k tr) with id, t, tick, sm, tid, title, from, to, causes and writes, and input items (k in) with id, t, tick, name and value
An input set to the value it already has shall produce no timeline item
The causes of a transition shall be the union of the items that last produced each name in its trigger, folded through equations and row results, which never appear as items
Exit and entry action writes of a transition shall be attached to that transition's writes in the same tick, and later readers of those variables shall treat the transition as their cause
Writes by during and init actions shall not create items; later readers of those variables shall treat the machine's last transition as their cause
The recorder shall keep at most 20,000 items, dropping the oldest first
The server shall send a timeline message with gen and all items so far to each client on connect
Each state message shall carry t (simulation ms), gen and tl (the items added since the previous broadcast)
Reset shall start a new timeline with a new gen, and the browser shall clear the timeline when gen changes
When the items added since the previous broadcast exceed 2,000, the server shall send a full timeline message instead of a delta

The Timeline pane shall be at the bottom of the page, full width below the left and right panes, hidden by default, and a Timeline button in the run bar shall show and hide it with a pressed look while shown; showing or hiding shall change nothing else on the page

A horizontal splitter on top of the pane shall resize it by dragging or ArrowUp/ArrowDown (20 px), default height 260 px, minimum 120 px, maximum 70% of the window; visibility and height shall be remembered in the browser
The lanes shall have a 140 px label column, a first row Inputs, then one lane per state machine in master order labelled with its display name
Each state shall be a bar from entry to exit (or to now), coloured by its position in the machine's file from a palette of 8 muted colours, with the state name drawn in the bar when it fits
Each transition shall be a vertical tick at the state boundary labelled with the transition id, and hovering it shall show its title and from -> to
The Inputs row shall show a dot per input change labelled with the input name, and hovering it shall show name = value

The time axis shall be at the bottom in seconds, show the last 30 s, follow the run with a cursor line at the current time, stop following when scrolled back by wheel or drag, and show a Live button only then, which resumes following
Hovering or selecting a transition shall draw dashed lines to each of its causes (an input dot or another machine's transition), and equations shall never be shown

Clicking a transition or an input dot shall open a sequence chart below the lanes inside the pane, with lifelines Inputs and each machine involved, showing the clicked item and everything it caused in time order

In the sequence chart each cause shall be an arrow from its lifeline to the machine labelled with the transition id (title on hover), and each action write an arrow back to Inputs labelled var = value
A close button and the Escape key shall close the sequence chart
Reset shall clear the lanes and the sequence chart
The Timeline pane shall show the current session only, the same whether driven by hand or by a test

When a transition with a current_state fires and its machine entered that state since its previous pass, its trigger shall be the machine's own name plus every name its rows read except t, tick and dt, so its causes are the transition that entered the state and the items that produced the conditions already waiting; the start state shall not count as entered and global transitions shall not be gated

A Save as text button, shown with the Timeline pane, shall download the current run as plain text (also served at /timeline.txt): one line per input change and per transition in time order with its time, machine, from and to states and title, followed by what caused it (input changes and transitions, numbered) and its action writes

Changes of result variables shown on a panel (data-lit-by or data-show, such as the FMA mode texts) shall be recorded in the timeline as display items with their causes and listed in the text timeline as DISPLAY lines naming the panel, the text lit and the variable; the pane does not draw them

When a panel row of the master CSV has role fma, the run bar shall show Start recording and Stop recording buttons (one at a time, with a recording clock); without such a panel they shall not be shown; recording shall not affect the trace or the timeline

Stop shall turn the recording window into rows: the FMA at Start, then one row per input whose FMA changes left a different settled FMA, merging all FMA changes between one input and the next; inputs that change nothing on the FMA shall not be shown
A blank FMA at Start shall not be drawn: the first row is then only the caption Start of the manoeuvre and its time

Each row shall be labelled with the input that caused it, found by following the recorded causes back to the input, in plain English from the inputs CSV description and unit columns (Approach button pressed, Radio altitude set to 2500 ft), else the label or name

The report shall use the compact layout: a vertical list with a header (title, model, date, recording window, number of changes, layout name), each row indented a step more than the one before, and each FMA drawn from the FMA panel's own HTML and CSS with the lights of that moment

Stop shall open the report in a new window as an editable preview: title, description, captions (a rewrite replaces the recorded text), notes, show times, drag to reorder, hide rows, indent per row and step, undo and reset to the recording; the FMA snapshots shall not be editable
Save PNG shall save the preview as shown, without edit controls or hidden rows, as a PNG named after the title and the date; the title shall be remembered in the browser
If the FMA did not change during the recording, the report shall say so; a Reset while recording shall end the recording like Stop

The master CSV shall accept at most one aircraft row whose file_name is an aircraft type (e.g. A220); it shall bring in the panels listed in that type's aircraft.csv (columns file_name, type = panel, name, scale, role) as if they were master panel rows
An aircraft type shall be the folder aircraft/<type>/ next to the master CSV if it has an aircraft.csv, else the built-in folder in the statesim package; the A220 shall be built in

An undefined aircraft type, a second aircraft row, a type name with a path in it, or a second fma role across the type's panels and the master's panel rows shall be a load error with its file:line; the message for an undefined type shall name the defined types
